title: 三更悟暗号
subtitle: 看懂提示之后，也要先确认
origin: 《西游记》第二回（低龄温和改编补遗）

moral.zh: 留心观察能帮助我们理解别人，但重要的事情仍要礼貌确认，不能只靠猜。
moral.en: Careful observation helps us understand others, but important things should still be confirmed politely rather than guessed.

pages.zh: 猴王来到方寸山，菩提祖师收他为徒，赐名孙悟空。一天，他和师兄们围坐听课。
pages.en: After the Monkey King reached Mount Fangcun, Master Puti accepted him and named him Sun Wukong. One day, he sat with the other students for a lesson.
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_NO_STAFF]] [[MASTER_PUTI]] Wukong sits with young temple students in a warm wooden hall, listening carefully to Master Puti; calm lesson, scrolls without readable text.

pages.zh: 祖师忽然在桌边轻轻敲了三下，又把手背到身后，微微一笑。
pages.en: The Master gently tapped the table three times, folded his hands behind him, and smiled.
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_NO_STAFF]] [[MASTER_PUTI]] Master Puti taps a wooden table exactly three times with one finger; Wukong notices while classmates remain curious.

pages.zh: 悟空想：是三天以后？第三间屋？还是夜里三更？他没有马上跑出去。
pages.en: Did it mean three days, the third room, or the third watch of night? Wukong did not rush away.
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_NO_STAFF]] Wukong pauses thoughtfully in the courtyard beside three harmless picture clues: three moon-shaped stones, three doors, and three seed pods; no text.

pages.zh: 下课后，他先把扫帚和水桶归位，再去问守夜师兄什么时候最安静。
pages.en: After class, he put away the broom and bucket, then asked when the temple was quietest.
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_NO_STAFF]] Wukong neatly returns a broom and bucket, then politely asks an older student beside a moon clock made of blank wooden symbols.

pages.zh: 到了三更，悟空轻轻敲门：“师父，是您让我来的吗？”
pages.en: At the third watch, Wukong knocked softly. “Master, did you mean for me to come?”
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_NO_STAFF]] Wukong softly knocks at a quiet study door under moonlight, hands respectful and expression hopeful; warm lamplight inside.

pages.zh: 祖师点点头：“你看懂了提示，还知道先确认，这比猜中更重要。”
pages.en: The Master nodded. “You understood the clue and still confirmed it. That matters more than a lucky guess.”
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_NO_STAFF]] [[MASTER_PUTI]] Master Puti welcomes Wukong into the moonlit study with a kind nod; open hands, intimate teacher-student warmth.

pages.zh: 祖师展开一幅无字云图，教他先看风向，再学腾云的第一步。
pages.en: The Master opened a wordless cloud chart and taught him to read the wind before learning cloud travel.
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_NO_STAFF]] [[MASTER_PUTI]] They study a wordless painted cloud-and-wind diagram on a low table; Wukong traces a safe curved route with one finger.

pages.zh: 天亮前，悟空把图卷好放回原处。他明白：聪明，也要配上礼貌和耐心。
pages.en: Before dawn, Wukong returned the chart neatly. He learned that cleverness works best with courtesy and patience.
pages.prompt: [[WUKONG_NO_STAFF]] [[MASTER_PUTI]] At first light Wukong carefully returns the rolled chart to a shelf while Master Puti smiles; peaceful temple garden beyond.
